results.controls: Remove group entities, details, cancel, confirm
results.expected: One guarded save commits policy exclusions; a concise result remains without Undo after the group disappears.
evidence: Actual group action, short confirmation, collapsed Details, Cancel, one saved entity/device exclusion change and no Undo after the group disappears; top-level History and Issues navigation preserve the save. Unknown/off siblings and notification settings preserved.

results.expected: Only reviewed saved policy exclusions change; unrelated drafts and HA state remain intact.
evidence: Actual Stop, Cancel, confirm, reopen and Resume controls, with no saved-action Undo; exact two-policy exclusions; unchanged unavailable state and unrelated unsaved policy/method drafts.

results.controls: Select members, stop selected, resume selected, exclusions filter
results.expected: One save affects only selected entities; excluded members remain reachable.
evidence: Device checkboxes select exactly two entities for one save; omitted excluded members remain reachable for selective resumption; exclusion filter retains only excluded branches.

results.controls: Dirty affected policy, stale review, save failure, deliberate retry
results.expected: Block unsafe scope changes and preserve saved settings and drafts.
evidence: Actual controls block affected drafts, stale settings and changed catalogs; disconnected controls are read-only; rejected saves accept deliberate retry; lost applied-save response has no automatic retry or false success and refresh prevents a duplicate write.

results.controls: Issue scope disclosure, acknowledge and pause dialogs, cancel
results.expected: Controls identify the whole correlated issue and preserve its exact identity.
evidence: Expanded Actions for this issue, read scope, opened and cancelled Acknowledge and Pause dialogs for exact correlated issue id; no action request sent.

results.controls: Collapsed details, retained focus, phone/desktop and themes
results.expected: Condition and actions remain visible; secondary details are reachable without horizontal scroll.
evidence: Actual disclosures retain focus through rerender; Stop review/Cancel work at 320, 390 and 1200 CSS pixels in light and dark; no required horizontal scrolling; primary action meets 44px touch target. Physical Safari untested.
